derived-channel.name: gatewayText

derived-channel.name: controllerText
derived-channel.expr: if($project == null or $project.get(`ehome.project:Project#controller`) == null, #('The project has no controller.'@en, 'Das Projekt hat keinen Controller.'@de), #('Controller of the project: {0}'@en, 'Controller des Projekts: {0}'@de).fill($project.get(`ehome.project:Project#controller`).get(`ehome.runtime:Controller#name`)))
